title: The Lighter Brief
overview: Charlotte had itself a weekend: the Panthers won a wild one to stretch their division lead, and Charlotte FC grabbed a last-gasp playoff win. A recount in western North Carolina wrapped up a historic House majority for Democrats. Elsewhere, IShowSpeed raced in front of Usain Bolt, Wale played principal for a day, and there's a new thumb joint that's helping people with arthritis.

stories.headline: Panthers Edge Ravens 35-33 in a Real Rollercoaster
stories.summary: Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes and Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards and two more scores as Carolina beat Baltimore in a game with seven lead changes, trick plays, a kickoff-return TD and a safety. A late interception sealed it, and with Tampa Bay and New Orleans both losing, the Panthers now have a two-game lead in the NFC South.
key_facts: Final score: Panthers 35, Ravens 33; Ryan Fitzgerald's 37-yard field goal with 1:44 left decided it
Rookie Will Lee III forced two fumbles and broke up the final pass, which Tyrel Dodson intercepted
Panthers (5-5) lead the NFC South by two games with seven left, their first two-game division lead since the 2015 Super Bowl season
Next up: at Tampa Bay on Nov. 30
stories.why: Charlotte fans get a genuinely fun win and a real shot at a second straight division title.

stories.headline: Recount Confirms Chuck Hubbard's Win Over Rep. Virginia Foxx
stories.summary: Democrat Chuck Hubbard has won North Carolina's 5th Congressional District, and longtime Republican Rep. Virginia Foxx conceded Sunday after a recount didn't change the outcome. Both candidates offered gracious words about the handoff.
key_facts: Hubbard won by 330 votes out of about 287,000 cast
Foxx had held the seat since first being elected in 2004 and chairs the House Rules Committee
Hubbard is a longtime journalist who started at his family's local newspaper
Democrats won 11 of North Carolina's 14 House seats, and Roy Cooper won a U.S. Senate seat
stories.why: Western North Carolina gets a new representative in January, and the race was a reminder of how much a few hundred votes can decide.

stories.headline: Charlotte FC Wins a Playoff Thriller in the 11th Minute of Stoppage Time
stories.summary: Pep Biel scored on the rebound of his own penalty kick deep into stoppage time to give Charlotte FC a 2-1 win at the Chicago Fire. It's the first regulation-time playoff win in club history.
key_facts: Liel Abada headed Charlotte in front early in the second half; Robert Lewandowski equalized for Chicago in the 68th minute
Chicago had just subbed in goalkeeper Josh Cohen, likely planning for a shootout
Charlotte is the No. 5 seed (16-10-9); Chicago is No. 4
The series continues in Charlotte on Saturday
stories.why: A club-history first, and a home playoff match to look forward to this weekend.

stories.headline: Charlotte Thanksgiving Forecast: Some Fog, Some Sun, Then More Rain
stories.summary: After a soggy weekend, Monday brings morning fog and then a mild, partly cloudy afternoon. Things cool down Tuesday, and another round of rain arrives Wednesday into Thanksgiving Day.
key_facts: Monday: patchy fog through midday, highs in the 60s and 70s
Wednesday: showers and chilly, highs in the upper 40s
Thanksgiving: about 10 degrees warmer, with rain tapering off in the early afternoon
Friday into the weekend: mostly sunny, breezy, highs in the upper 50s
stories.why: Handy if you're traveling Wednesday. Pack an umbrella and allow some extra time.

stories.headline: Democrats Reach 258 House Seats, the Biggest Majority This Century
stories.summary: With the North Carolina recount settled, House Democrats reached 258 seats, a 44-seat gain and the largest post-election majority for any party since 1992. Democrats will also control the Senate, so Washington will have divided government for the last two years of President Trump's term.
key_facts: Republicans hold at least 173 seats, with four races still uncalled
Hakeem Jeffries is set to become the first Black House speaker when Congress convenes in January
Democratic leaders say they're planning a 100-day agenda focused on cost of living, plus investigations of the administration
The Senate is also under Democratic control
stories.why: The balance of power in Congress is shifting in January, which will shape which bills move forward on things like prices and the economy.

stories.headline: Jamaica's Young Reggae Boyz Aim to Bounce Back at the U-17 World Cup
stories.summary: After a 6-0 opening loss to European champions Italy, Jamaica's Under-17 team faces Uzbekistan on Monday. Coach Wendell Downswell says the staff has been working on the mental and tactical sides of the game and that spirits in camp are high.
key_facts: Jamaica plays in Group E at the FIFA U-17 World Cup
Their opener was a 6-0 loss to Italy
They play Uzbekistan Monday, then Ivory Coast in the final group game
stories.why: It's a nice underdog moment: a young team getting a chance to show it can respond to a rough start.

stories.headline: Golding Asks PM Holness to Take Another Look at the Spring Mount Road
stories.summary: Jamaica's Opposition Leader Mark Golding walked the narrow, broken-off Spring Mount road in St James and asked Prime Minister Andrew Holness to see it in person and order engineering assessments. The government says a fix would cost about $250 million and might fail again within five years, and that the money would serve more people if spent on other roads.
key_facts: The PM estimated the repair at about $250 million
Works Minister Robert Nesta Morgan pointed to longer alternative routes via Anchovy–Roehampton and Charliemont
Residents currently walk a narrow path along the drop, which is hard for children and the elderly
stories.why: It's a real everyday problem for local families, and a fair debate over how to spend limited road money.

stories.headline: IShowSpeed Sprints for Usain Bolt and Clocks 10.35
stories.summary: In a new YouTube video, streamer IShowSpeed raced the clock while Usain Bolt and coach Ato Boldon watched, calling it a lifelong dream. He's also launching a series called Speed Goes Pro, training with Boldon toward the 2028 Olympic trials.
key_facts: His best time on the day was 10.35 seconds; his goal was 10.09
Bolt's world record is 9.58
Bolt said that's impressive by any track person's standard, then laughed off any comparison to himself
stories.why: It's a sweet one: a kid who grew up watching Bolt on his mom's computer got coached by his hero.
